cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是BBC World Service的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: I'm Pete Ross, and in the early hours of Sunday the 13th of September, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是皮特·罗斯。现在是9月13日星期日凌晨，以下是主要新闻。

cues.en: The right-wing party Reform UK gets another donation of nearly $50 million, the second in as many days from a cryptocurrency billionaire.
cues.zh: 右翼政党Reform UK又获近5000万美元捐款；两天内这是加密货币亿万富翁的第二笔捐款。

cues.en: And the first way of thinking about it that I had was maybe it's not pointless for people to see what terrorism looks like.
cues.zh: 我最初的想法是，也许让人们看看恐怖主义的样子并非毫无意义。

cues.en: I'm going to tell the story, and the attacker doesn't get to be the storyteller.
cues.zh: 我要讲述这个故事，不能让袭击者成为讲故事的人。

cues.en: The author Salman Rushdie discusses a new film about the vicious knife attack that left him blind in one eye.
cues.zh: 作家萨尔曼·鲁西迪谈论一部新电影，内容是那场令他一只眼睛失明的残酷持刀袭击。

cues.en: Also in this podcast, at least 16 people have died in a fire at a nursing home in Chile.
cues.zh: 本期还将报道：智利一家养老院发生火灾，至少16人死亡。

cues.en: And in tennis, Elena Rybakina has become the US Open women's singles champion.
cues.zh: 网球方面，埃琳娜·雷巴金娜成为美国网球公开赛女单冠军。

cues.en: Nigel Farage has been a disruptor in British politics for many years and was a key figure in the Brexit movement.
cues.zh: 奈杰尔·法拉奇多年来一直是英国政治的搅局者，也是脱欧运动的关键人物。

cues.en: That movement saw the UK vote to leave the European Union.
cues.zh: 这场运动促使英国投票决定脱离欧盟。

cues.en: Some have even tipped him to be the next prime minister.
cues.zh: 甚至有人预测他会成为下一任首相。

cues.en: Now, his populist right-wing party, Reform UK,
cues.zh: 如今，他领导的民粹主义右翼政党改革党，

cues.en: which has been accused of stoking violent anti-immigration protests,
cues.zh: 被指煽动暴力反移民抗议，

cues.en: has received almost $100 million in donations in the space of two days by the cryptocurrency billionaires Ben Delo and Christopher Harborne.
cues.zh: 在两天内从加密货币亿万富翁 Ben Delo 和 Christopher Harborne 处获得了近1亿美元捐款。

cues.en: The party's deputy leader, Richard Tice, said there was nothing wrong with receiving such a huge sum of money.
cues.zh: 该党副党首 Richard Tice 表示，接受如此巨额资金并无不妥。

cues.en: We should celebrate when entrepreneurs want to help a country in serious difficulty and provide greater choice to voters. That's the key thing.
cues.zh: 企业家愿意帮助陷入严重困境的国家，并为选民提供更多选择时，我们应该庆祝。这才是关键。

cues.en: And to have that support, to know that we can focus on employing the best people,
cues.zh: 有了这种支持，我们就能专注于聘用最优秀的人才，

cues.en: whether it be on social media, policy, campaign managers, that's a good thing.
cues.zh: 无论是负责社交媒体、政策还是竞选事务的人员，这都是好事。

cues.en: Nigel Farage is already being investigated by the British Parliament over whether he should have declared a cash gift of $7 million from Mr. Harborne.
cues.zh: 英国议会已经在调查奈杰尔·法拉奇是否应申报 Harborne 先生赠送的700万美元现金。

cues.en: He has said it's not the public's business to know details of how he spends that money.
cues.zh: 他表示，自己如何花这笔钱的细节不关公众的事。

cues.en: Reform UK itself is also the subject of a probe by the police over donations to the party, which denies any wrongdoing.
cues.zh: 改革党本身也因党内捐款受到警方调查，但该党否认有任何不当行为。

cues.en: The governing Labour Party has said that Mr. Farage can't buy his way out of the 'sleaze and scandal' he and Reform UK are drowning in.
cues.zh: 执政党工党表示，法拉奇无法靠钱摆脱他和改革党深陷的“肮脏丑闻”。

cues.en: Margaret Hodge, the British government's anti-corruption champion, said that donations on this scale were of great concern.
cues.zh: 英国政府反腐事务负责人 Margaret Hodge 说，如此规模的捐款令人非常担忧。

cues.en: This does represent a very dangerous challenge to our democracy when you get a couple of billionaires who capture one of our political parties
cues.zh: 当两位亿万富翁控制了我们的一个政党时，这确实对我们的民主构成了非常危险的挑战；

cues.en: and at best influence, and at worst control, our democracy through those political parties.
cues.zh: 他们至多是通过这些政党影响民主，最坏的情况则是控制民主。

cues.en: For more on the donations, I spoke to our political correspondent, Rob Watson.
cues.zh: 关于这些捐款的更多情况，我采访了本台政治记者 Rob Watson。

cues.en: They are massive figures. I have been covering British politics on and off for about four decades,
cues.zh: 这些数字非常庞大。我断断续续报道英国政治大约四十年了，

cues.en: and I know that these are by far and away the largest donations given by individuals to a political party ever.
cues.zh: 我知道，这绝对是个人向政党捐出的最大金额。

cues.en: There's just been nothing like this.
cues.zh: 此前从未出现过这样的情况。

cues.en: And again, to put them in context, these two donations amount to more than all the money the major parties got last year put together,
cues.zh: 再举例说明，这两笔捐款加起来，比去年所有主要政党获得的资金总和还多。

cues.en: And it's much more money than the two main parties, the Conservatives and Labour, spent at the last general election in 2024.
cues.zh: 这笔钱也远多于两大政党——保守党和工党——在2024年上次大选中花费的资金。

cues.en: So staggering. Why are these two billionaires doing it?
cues.zh: 这实在惊人。他们为何要这样做？

cues.en: I think, based on what they've said, it's their sort of passionate belief, along with a lot of Reform supporters,
cues.zh: 我认为，根据他们的说法，这体现了他们以及许多改革党支持者的热诚信念：

cues.en: that goes something like this, Pete, that something's gone profoundly wrong in Britain.
cues.zh: 英国出了严重的问题。

cues.en: Much of that to do with immigration, much of that to do with too much wokery,
cues.zh: 其中很大一部分与移民有关，也与所谓的“觉醒政治”过多有关，

cues.en: and that only Reform and Nigel Farage, its leader, can put it right.
cues.zh: 而只有改革党及其领导人奈杰尔·法拉奇能够扭转局面。

cues.en: So that is the explanation, but the sums are staggering. And historic in their size.
cues.zh: 这就是他们的解释，但金额之大令人震惊，其规模也创下历史纪录。

cues.en: And what about these two individuals that have made these huge donations?
cues.zh: 那么，这两位捐出巨款的人呢？

cues.en: Can you tell us a bit more about them and why they've got the ability to spend in one go what is, as we've said, a very large amount of money?
cues.zh: 能否介绍一下他们，以及他们为何有能力一次性花掉我们所说的这笔巨款？

cues.en: So yes, both of them are fabulously wealthy cryptocurrency investors.
cues.zh: 是的，他们都是极其富有的加密货币投资者。

cues.en: They tend to be in that sort of class of billionaire who are sort of very pro-entrepreneur,
cues.zh: 他们属于那类非常支持企业家的亿万富翁，

cues.en: who think that Britain has become sort of tied down with regulation, with red tape,
cues.zh: 他们认为英国受到监管和繁文缛节的束缚，

cues.en: and it's why donors like these two also tended to support Britain leaving the European Union.
cues.zh: 因此，像他们这样的捐赠者也往往支持英国脱离欧盟。

cues.en: Is this good news for Reform? On the one hand, it's fabulous news, right? What political party would turn down such riches?
cues.zh: 那么，这对改革党算是个好消息吗？一方面，这当然是天大的好消息。哪个政党会拒绝这样的财富？

cues.en: It's also fabulous news because there had been concern that negative stories about Reform, Nigel Farage and their financing,
cues.zh: 这也是好消息，因为此前有人担心，关于改革党、奈杰尔·法拉奇及其资金的负面报道，

cues.en: might put people off from donating to Reform because they wouldn't want to get into the news.
cues.zh: 可能会让人们不愿捐款给改革党，因为他们不想登上新闻。

cues.en: Well, now Reform has all this money, it presumably won't need to be attracting large amounts of cash.
cues.zh: 如今改革党有了这么多钱，想必不需要再吸引大笔现金了。

cues.en: It's also good news, this huge amount of money.
cues.zh: 这笔巨款也有好处。

cues.en: If current Prime Minister Andy Burnham decided to call an early general election, they'd have lots and lots of money.
cues.zh: 例如，如果现任首相安迪·伯纳姆决定提前举行大选，他们就会拥有大笔资金。

cues.en: On the other hand, the problem with donations like this is that it allows your political opponents to say,
cues.zh: 另一方面，这类捐款的问题在于，会让政敌有机会说：

cues.en: Hang on a minute, Reform. You say you are the party
cues.zh: 等一下，改革党。你们说自己是代表

cues.en: of the ordinary person, the working-class person on the street,
cues.zh: 普通人、街头工薪阶层的政党，

cues.en: But hang on a minute, you depend on super-wealthy billionaires who make money in ways most people don't understand.
cues.zh: 但等一下，你们依赖超级富豪和亿万富翁，而大多数人并不了解他们赚钱的方式。

cues.en: But past evidence has shown that when parties have had huge donations, it still won't help you win an election
cues.zh: 但过去的证据表明，即使政党获得巨额捐款，也不一定能帮助你赢得选举，

cues.en: if, you know, the message that you're trying to sell is not one that goes down with the voters.
cues.zh: 如果你试图推销的理念不受选民欢迎。

cues.en: So this massive sum of money does not by any means mean the next election is in the bag
cues.zh: 所以，这笔巨款绝不意味着下一场选举已经胜券在握，

cues.en: for Reform and Nigel Farage. Rob Watson.
cues.zh: 改革党和奈杰尔·法拉奇还不能这么认为。罗布·沃森报道。

cues.en: It's four years since the attempted murder on a stage in New York State of the controversial Indian-British novelist Salman Rushdie.
cues.zh: 四年前，备受争议的英籍印度裔小说家萨尔曼·鲁西迪在纽约州舞台上遭遇谋杀未遂。

cues.en: A new film about the incident is soon to be released,
cues.zh: 一部关于这起事件的新电影即将上映，

cues.en: based on never-before-seen footage of the attack, taken by his wife, the cinematographer Rachel Eliza Griffiths, and of his recovery.
cues.zh: 影片根据他妻子、摄影师蕾切尔·伊丽莎·格里菲思拍摄的袭击现场及其康复过程的未公开影像制作。

cues.en: Justin Webb spoke to Mr. Rushdie and the director of the film, Alex Gibney.
cues.zh: 贾斯廷·韦布采访了鲁西迪先生和电影导演亚历克斯·吉布尼。

cues.en: He began by asking how the project started,
cues.zh: 他先询问这个项目是如何开始的，

cues.en: and just a warning that some of their discussion contains graphic details about the aftermath of the attack.
cues.zh: 先提醒一句，他们的部分讨论包含袭击后果的具体画面描述。

cues.en: Initially, we weren't thinking clearly at all. We were just doing it to have some record of this terrible thing.
cues.zh: 起初，我们完全无法清晰思考，只是想为这件可怕的事留下一些记录。

cues.en: We live in an age where everything must be recorded, or it didn't happen.
cues.zh: 如今这个时代，凡事都必须记录下来，否则就好像从未发生过。

cues.en: And it was only when I was back home that my wife said to me, 'Was I ready to see this stuff?'
cues.zh: 直到我回到家，妻子才问我：“你准备好看这些东西了吗？”

cues.en: And I said, 'Okay.' And she set up a screen and a projector, and we sat together and watched it.
cues.zh: 我说：“好。”她架起屏幕和投影仪，我们坐在一起观看。

cues.en: And amongst other things, what I thought is that the filmmaking was very good.
cues.zh: 除此之外，我还觉得影片拍得非常好。

cues.en: I thought, this isn't a home movie. It looks more professional,
cues.zh: 我想，这看起来不像家庭录像，更像是专业制作的作品，

cues.en: maybe if it's of that quality, then there is some reason for it to have a wider life.
cues.zh: 既然质量这么高，或许有理由让它得到更广泛的传播。

cues.en: And eventually, we were introduced to Alex Gibney, and he also thought it was good.
cues.zh: 后来我们认识了亚历克斯·吉布尼，他也觉得影片很好。

cues.en: Alex, you thought it was good. What could you do with it?
cues.zh: 亚历克斯，你觉得影片很好。你当时认为自己可以如何处理它？

cues.en: Was it immediately obvious to you?
cues.zh: 这件事对你来说当时就很明显吗？

cues.en: Well, it was immediately obvious that there was an extraordinary film here.
cues.zh: 当时很明显，这里有一部非同寻常的电影。

cues.en: Exactly what to do with it, I wasn't 100% sure.
cues.zh: 但具体该怎么做，我当时并不是百分之百确定。

cues.en: In fact, the first question I asked Salman and Eliza is, you know, why don't you do it?
cues.zh: 事实上，我问萨尔曼和伊莉莎的第一个问题是：你们为什么不自己来做呢？

cues.en: And I think they had considered that, but felt that it was too close to them,
cues.zh: 我想他们考虑过，但觉得这件事离他们太近了，

cues.en: And so that I could perform a service in the sense that I would see it from the outside, and therefore have some sense of how to present it to the audience.
cues.zh: 所以我可以从局外人的角度来帮忙，从而判断该如何呈现给观众。

cues.en: But I did have an idea based on a British television series called The Singing Detective.
cues.zh: 不过，我确实有个想法，灵感来自英国电视剧《歌唱侦探》。

cues.en: And what's interesting about that series is that the simple story is a story of physical recovery.
cues.zh: 那部剧有意思的地方在于，它表面上讲的是身体康复的故事。

cues.en: A guy shows up in a hospital with psoriatic arthropathy, full of lesions and in terrible pain, and over the course of it, he physically recovers.
cues.zh: 一个患有银屑病性关节病的人来到医院，浑身是皮损、疼痛难忍，后来逐渐恢复了身体健康。

cues.en: But along the way, he has these hallucinations. He thinks back to his childhood.
cues.zh: 但在这个过程中，他产生了幻觉，回想起自己的童年。

cues.en: He imagines bits and pieces of his own detective fiction sort of intermingling with his personal thoughts and memories and desires.
cues.zh: 他想象着自己侦探小说中的片段，与个人的思想、记忆和欲望交织在一起。

cues.en: So, I thought a kind of a mindscape that would move in and out of a simple story of physical recovery would be interesting.
cues.zh: 所以我想，如果让一种心灵景观出入于这个简单的身体康复故事，应该会很有意思。

cues.en: So, this is not a film about a recovery that just goes chronologically through that recovery; it's much more than that.
cues.zh: 所以，这不是一部按时间顺序讲述康复过程的电影；它远不止于此。

cues.en: And in purpose, Salman, what is it?
cues.zh: 那么，这部电影的主旨是什么，萨尔曼？

cues.en: Well, the first way of thinking about it that I had was maybe it's not pointless for people to see what terrorism looks like
cues.zh: 我最初想到的是，也许让人们看看恐怖主义是什么样子，并不是没有意义。

cues.en: And see it close up and unvarnished.
cues.zh: 近距离、不加修饰地看清它。

cues.en: This is what an eye looks like when it's hanging out of your head. This is what a neck looks like when it's been slashed.
cues.zh: 这就是眼球从头部脱出时的样子。这就是脖子被割伤后的样子。

cues.en: So, I just thought: tell the story in an age when there is so much violence that we are almost inured to it.
cues.zh: 所以我想，应该讲出这个故事：在这个暴力如此泛滥、我们几乎已经麻木的时代，

cues.en: Especially if you live in America and there's murders every day, murders of children at school, mass murders.
cues.zh: 尤其是在美国，每天都有谋杀，有在学校遇害的孩子，还有大规模谋杀。

cues.en: For no reason, human life feels much cheaper than it should.
cues.zh: 毫无理由地，人的生命显得比本应显得的更加廉价。

cues.en: And one way I thought of understanding how this man thought is that it's a kind of an American story.
cues.zh: 我认为，理解这个人想法的一种方式，是把它看作某种美国式的故事。

cues.en: If you are so used to the cheapening of human life, it may be easier to conceive of taking it.
cues.zh: 如果你已经习惯了人的生命被贬低，也许就更容易产生夺走生命的念头。

cues.en: Salman's already starting to work on Knife, the book, the memoir.
cues.zh: 萨尔曼已经开始着手写《刀锋》这本回忆录。

cues.en: And one of the things that he said, as I recall,
cues.zh: 我记得，他说过的一点是，

cues.en: what was interesting to him was the idea of moving from an act of hate to a place of love.
cues.zh: 对他来说，有意思的是从仇恨的行为走向爱的境地。

cues.en: And that was very interesting to me too, because I had spent a good bit of my time doing films about the dark side of human nature.
cues.zh: 这对我也很有意思，因为我花了相当多时间拍摄关于人性阴暗面的电影。

cues.en: And indeed, there is a film I did called Taxi to the Dark Side, which is all about terror.
cues.zh: 我确实拍过一部叫《通往黑暗面的出租车》的电影，讲的就是恐怖。

cues.en: But I thought, wouldn't it be interesting to kind of flip the script and show
cues.zh: 但我想，如果反转这个剧本，展现出

cues.en: not only the face of terror in the form of the wounds that had been inflicted on Salman, but also how you recover from that,
cues.zh: 不仅是恐怖的面孔——萨尔曼身上留下的伤口，也展现人如何从中恢复，

cues.en: both physically and spiritually and psychologically, to be able to embrace life again?
cues.zh: 无论是身体上、精神上还是心理上，最终重新拥抱生活？

cues.en: At the end, Salman calls it reconstructed happiness. I was interested in reconstructing happiness.
cues.zh: 你知道，最后萨尔曼说，那是一种重建的幸福。我对重建幸福这个想法很感兴趣。

cues.en: I've always disliked thinking of myself as a victim, and in a way,
cues.zh: 我一直不喜欢把自己看成受害者，而在某种程度上，

cues.en: doing this double project of writing this book and making this film was a way of taking charge of it.
cues.zh: 写这本书和拍这部电影这个双重项目，是我掌握这件事主动权的一种方式。

cues.en: I'm going to tell the story. I'm going to say what it means, and the attacker doesn't get to be the storyteller.
cues.zh: 我要讲述这个故事，我要说出它意味着什么，而攻击者不能成为讲故事的人。

cues.en: He's had his 15 minutes of Andy Warhol-type fame, and he can now go back into obscurity for the rest of his life.
cues.zh: 他已经享受了属于自己的十五分钟安迪·沃霍尔式名声，现在可以在余生回归默默无闻。

cues.en: Sir Salman Rushdie and the film director Alex Gibney, speaking to Justin Webb.
cues.zh: 萨尔曼·鲁西迪爵士和电影导演亚历克斯·吉布尼接受了贾斯廷·韦布的采访。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast, a crucial general election in Sweden.
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后将播出：瑞典一场至关重要的大选。

cues.en: They have been very much mainstreamed, but they're still, you know, a very radical party for the views of many voters.
cues.zh: 他们已经很大程度上进入主流，但在许多选民看来，他们仍然是一个非常激进的政党。

cues.en: Amid rising support for the far-right Sweden Democrats.
cues.zh: 背景是极右翼瑞典民主党的支持率正在上升。

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: Yemen says it has struck Houthi fighters in the strategic coastal city of Mokha.
cues.zh: 也门称已在战略要地、沿海城市穆哈打击胡塞武装。

cues.en: It comes a day after the Iranian-backed armed group seized control of the entire Red Sea coast.
cues.zh: 这发生在这个伊朗支持的武装组织控制整个红海沿岸一天之后。

cues.en: threatening to block the Bab al-Mandab Strait, a vital artery for Saudi oil exports.
cues.zh: 这威胁到封锁曼德海峡——这条海峡是沙特石油出口的重要通道。

cues.en: Saudi Arabia has closed a critical oil pipeline after it was hit by drones launched from Iraq, and has said it won't retaliate for now.
cues.zh: 沙特阿拉伯关闭了一条重要输油管道，此前该管道遭到从伊拉克发射的无人机袭击；沙特称目前不会报复。

cues.en: Djibouti, which sits on the other side of the strait, says 1,400 people have fled to it from Yemen
cues.zh: 位于海峡另一侧的吉布提称，有1400人从也门逃到该国，

cues.en: in just 24 hours because of the fighting between Yemeni government forces and Houthi militias.
cues.zh: 仅仅24小时内，因为也门政府军与胡塞民兵之间的战斗。

cues.en: Our Middle East correspondent Hugo Bachega has been speaking to Ankur Desai about the fighting.
cues.zh: 我们的中东记者雨果·巴切加一直在就战事采访安库尔·德赛。

cues.en: It's difficult to get a clear picture of what's happening on the ground,
cues.zh: 目前很难弄清地面上究竟发生了什么，

cues.en: but we had a statement from the government in Yemen saying that its forces had carried out some airstrikes
cues.zh: 但我们得到也门政府的一份声明，称其部队实施了空袭，

cues.en: targeting Houthi positions in Mokha, and this was actually confirmed by a Houthi spokesperson
cues.zh: 目标是穆哈的胡塞阵地；一名胡塞发言人也证实了这一点，

cues.en: who said a number of fighters had been killed.
cues.zh: 他称有数名武装人员被杀。

cues.en: Now, Mokha is a strategically located port on the Red Sea,
cues.zh: 穆哈是红海上一座地理位置重要的港口，

cues.en: and I think we haven't seen any kind of organized response from the government yet.
cues.zh: 我认为政府尚未作出任何有组织的回应。

cues.en: There have been reports saying that government forces were shocked by the lack of support from the Saudis.
cues.zh: 有报道称，政府军对沙特方面缺乏支持感到震惊。

cues.en: The Saudis, obviously, have been supporting the government in this fight against the Houthis.
cues.zh: 显然，沙特一直在这场对胡塞武装的战斗中支持也门政府。

cues.en: There have also been lots of divisions among members of this anti-Houthi coalition in Yemen
cues.zh: 也门反胡塞联盟的成员之间也存在许多分歧。

cues.en: so it does seem that the Houthis may have spotted an opportunity to make these gains.
cues.zh: 因此，胡塞武装似乎抓住了扩大这些战果的机会。

cues.en: What are the chances this could plunge the country
cues.zh: 这会把也门拖入全面冲突的可能性有多大？

cues.en: back into a full-scale conflict? We've seen periods of relative calm in Yemen compared with the height of the civil war.
cues.zh: 毕竟，与内战最激烈时相比，也门曾有过相对平静的时期。

cues.en: Yeah, there have been years of relative quiet in Yemen
cues.zh: 是的，也门已经多年相对平静，

cues.en: and we still don't know if the government and its Saudi supporters will mount a large-scale offensive against the Houthis to take back this territory.
cues.zh: 我们仍不知道政府及其沙特支持者是否会对胡塞发动大规模攻势，试图夺回这片领土。

cues.en: Don't forget that years of military action by that Saudi-led coalition against the Houthis failed to dislodge them
cues.zh: 别忘了，沙特领导的联盟多年对胡塞武装采取军事行动，却未能将其赶走，

cues.en: and the Saudis had been prioritizing diplomacy in recent years.
cues.zh: 而近年来，沙特一直把外交置于优先位置。

cues.en: I think it's interesting that President Trump today confirmed that he had a phone call with the Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman
cues.zh: 我认为有一点很有意思：特朗普总统今天确认，他曾与沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼通电话。

cues.en: who reportedly asked for an American intervention in Yemen, which was rejected.
cues.zh: 据报道，王储要求美国干预也门，但遭到了拒绝。

cues.en: So, I think this could indicate a strategy to contain these tensions and prevent the conflict from escalating further.
cues.zh: 所以我认为，这或许表明他们正试图遏制紧张局势，防止冲突进一步升级。

cues.en: The price of oil is rising. It's at over $100 a barrel.
cues.zh: 油价正在上涨，目前每桶已超过100美元。

cues.en: So if the Houthis are able to take control of this key choke point, the Bab al-Mandab Strait, just talk us through the implications of that.
cues.zh: 如果胡塞武装能够控制这个关键咽喉——曼德海峡，请谈谈这会带来什么影响。

cues.en: This advance has put the Houthis in a position to control this strategic Bab al-Mandab Strait.
cues.zh: 这次推进使胡塞武装得以控制具有战略意义的曼德海峡。

cues.en: This has been a key waterway for Saudi Arabia's oil exports, an alternative to the Strait of Hormuz
cues.zh: 这是沙特石油出口的一条重要水道，也是霍尔木兹海峡的替代通道，

cues.en: which has been effectively closed because of the US war against Iran.
cues.zh: 霍尔木兹海峡因美国与伊朗的战争而实际上关闭。

cues.en: A blockade by the Houthis could further squeeze global energy supplies, so many people are watching the situation.
cues.zh: 胡塞武装的封锁可能进一步压缩全球能源供应，所以许多人都在关注那里的局势。

cues.en: And any kind of action by the Houthis could also help Iran's strategy of driving up prices to put pressure on the US to end the war.
cues.zh: 胡塞武装的任何行动也可能帮助伊朗推高价格，向美国施压，迫使其结束战争。

cues.en: And I think, you know, these seemingly different conflicts are connected because it could end up being part of this Iranian strategy
cues.zh: 我认为，这些看似不同的冲突彼此相连，因为它们最终可能成为伊朗战略的一部分，

cues.en: of trying to put pressure on the US to come up with a deal to end the war.
cues.zh: 该战略试图向美国施压，促成结束战争的协议。

cues.en: Hugo Bachega, who's been monitoring developments from Jerusalem.
cues.zh: 雨果·巴切加一直在耶路撒冷关注事态发展。

cues.en: Now to Chile, where officials have declared a period of mourning after at least 16 elderly people were killed in a fire at a nursing home.
cues.zh: 现在转向智利。官员宣布哀悼期，此前一所养老院发生火灾，至少16名老人死亡。

cues.en: Ten residents were reportedly rescued after the blaze took hold at the building in Santiago.
cues.zh: 据报道，火灾席卷圣地亚哥这栋建筑后，有10名居民获救。

cues.en: I heard more from our Latin America specialist, Luis Fajardo.
cues.zh: 拉丁美洲事务记者路易斯·法哈多带来了更多消息。

cues.en: The facility in the south of Chile had been under investigation and had apparently been the object of several sanctions, according to Chilean media.
cues.zh: 据智利媒体报道，智利南部这家机构一直在接受调查，显然还曾多次受到制裁。

cues.en: Chilean news website BioBio, for example, was saying that there had been several irregularities.
cues.zh: 例如，智利新闻网站BioBio称那里存在多项违规行为。

cues.en: And the person who was taking care of the old people in this facility apparently did not have proper authorization for that.
cues.zh: 而这家机构中负责照料老人的人，显然没有相应的合法许可。

cues.en: So it is causing a great deal of concern.
cues.zh: 所以，这引发了极大的担忧。

cues.en: Moreover, there are reports that this facility had been the object of investigations and sanctions over the years, again because of irregularities.
cues.zh: 此外，据报道，这家机构多年来一直因违规行为接受调查并受到制裁。

cues.en: So there are a lot of questions being asked about why this facility had been allowed to continue operating.
cues.zh: 因此，人们纷纷追问，为什么这家机构一直被允许继续运营。

cues.en: And what's been the response in Chile? What are people there saying to this?
cues.zh: 智利方面对此有何回应？当地人对此怎么说？

cues.en: There's a lot of complaints, of course, against the people who were behind the facility,
cues.zh: 当然，人们对这家机构的负责人有很多抱怨，

cues.en: but also questions about how effective the government regulation of these facilities has been in Chile,
cues.zh: 也在质疑智利政府对这类机构的监管是否有效，

cues.en: as in many other countries in the region in Latin America.
cues.zh: 拉丁美洲地区许多其他国家也面临同样问题。

cues.en: There is a particular and growing concern about how old people are being taken care of by society,
cues.zh: 人们尤其越来越担心，社会如何照料老年人，

cues.en: because these countries are facing an increase in the number of old people in the community.
cues.zh: 因为这些国家社区中的老年人口正在增加。

cues.en: As society ages, a higher proportion of people are in old age,
cues.zh: 随着社会老龄化，老年人口所占比例越来越高，

cues.en: and there are questions about whether the regulation of these institutions has been effective.
cues.zh: 人们也在质疑这些机构是否得到了有效监管。

cues.en: And has the government said anything on this?
cues.zh: 那么，政府对此有过什么说法吗？

cues.en: There was a recent statement by the government of Chile saying that, indeed, the person taking care of the old people in this facility
cues.zh: 智利政府最近发表声明称，确实，这家机构中负责照料老人的人

cues.en: did not have the adequate documentation.
cues.zh: 并没有完备的证明文件。

cues.en: And they are, of course, promising more investigations and eventually sanctions to those being responsible.
cues.zh: 当然，政府承诺将进一步调查，并最终制裁相关责任人。

cues.en: Luis Fajardo.
cues.zh: 路易斯·法哈多。

cues.en: The people of Sweden are heading to the polls in what's expected to be a tight race between the centre-left and centre-right political blocs.
cues.zh: 瑞典民众将前往投票，预计中左翼和中右翼政治阵营之间的竞争会十分胶着。

cues.en: It is effectively a referendum on whether the far-right Sweden Democrats should join government and move from political outcasts to trusted partners.
cues.zh: 这实际上是在公投：极右翼瑞典民主党是否应加入政府，从政治弃儿转为受信任的伙伴。

cues.en: So, what is the main issue on voters' minds?
cues.zh: 那么，选民最关心的主要问题是什么？

cues.en: The BBC's Stephanie Zakrisson compiled this report.
cues.zh: BBC记者斯蒂芬妮·扎克里松制作了这篇报道。

cues.en: On a cold and rainy day in March, demonstrators gathered in a nationwide call against what had been labelled teenage deportation.
cues.zh: 三月一个寒冷多雨的日子里，示威者响应全国号召，反对所谓的“青少年驱逐”。

cues.en: Where young people who had lived in Sweden for many years were told they no longer had the right to stay,
cues.zh: 许多在瑞典生活多年的年轻人被告知，他们不再有权留下，

cues.en: they had turned 18 and were no longer deemed to be dependents of their foreign-born parents.
cues.zh: 因为他们已满18岁，不再被视为外籍父母的受抚养人。

cues.en: Headlines across Sweden told the stories of youngsters who'd learned Swedish, studied, made friends, to then be sent
cues.zh: 瑞典各地的头条讲述了这样的年轻人：他们学会瑞典语、求学、交友，却最终被送往

cues.en: to a country that many of them hadn't set foot in for years, prompting public outrage against the strict immigration laws.
cues.zh: 一个许多人多年未曾踏足的国家，引发公众对严苛移民法的愤怒。

cues.en: The centre-right government was forced to backtrack and pause the deportations.
cues.zh: 中右翼政府被迫改变立场，暂停驱逐行动。

cues.en: But the tough stance on immigration has been a trademark of Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson's coalition,
cues.zh: 但强硬的移民立场一直是首相乌尔夫·克里斯特松领导的联盟的标志，

cues.en: which is governing with the backing of the far-right Sweden Democrats.
cues.zh: 该联盟在极右翼瑞典民主党的支持下执政。

cues.en: Its leader, Jimmie Åkesson, had promised a paradigm shift in Swedish immigration policy.
cues.zh: 该党领袖吉米·奥克松曾承诺，让瑞典移民政策发生范式转变。

cues.en: The paradigm shift on immigration remains in place.
cues.zh: 移民政策的范式转变仍在持续。

cues.en: Four years on, the number of asylum seekers has plummeted.
cues.zh: 四年过去，寻求庇护者人数已大幅下降。

cues.en: Swedish citizenship now requires longer residence and a knowledge test.
cues.zh: 如今，申请瑞典国籍需要更长的居住时间和知识测试。

cues.en: And residence permits are strictly temporary.
cues.zh: 居留许可也严格限于临时期限。

cues.en: This is largely due to the leverage of the Sweden Democrats, a party founded by neo-Nazis,
cues.zh: 这主要得益于瑞典民主党的影响力；该党由新纳粹分子创建，

cues.en: and long treated as a pariah, but now the country's second-largest political force. They've had a very big influence.
cues.zh: 长期被视为弃儿，如今却已成为该国第二大政治力量。他们的影响力非常大。

cues.en: Jan Teorell is a professor of political science at Stockholm University.
cues.zh: 扬·特奥雷尔是斯德哥尔摩大学政治学教授。

cues.en: They have been very much mainstreamed, but in the view of many voters, they are still a very radical party.
cues.zh: 他们已经相当主流化，但在许多选民看来，仍然是一个非常激进的政党。

cues.en: And the other parties have had to adjust, particularly on the centre-right side, where the first approach was to basically ignore them,
cues.zh: 其他政党也不得不调整，尤其是中右翼阵营；他们最初的做法基本上是忽视瑞典民主党，

cues.en: but that shifted ahead of the last election,
cues.zh: 但在上次选举前，立场发生了转变，

cues.en: and now they've been a well-integrated support party for the government and have had very much policy influence in the last four years.
cues.zh: 如今，他们已成为政府充分整合的支持党，并在过去四年里深刻影响政策。

cues.en: When asked about Sweden's dramatic shift in immigration during his time as prime minister, Ulf Kristersson
cues.zh: 当被问及自己担任首相期间瑞典移民政策的剧烈转变时，乌尔夫·克里斯特松

cues.en: said his government had fulfilled its task of cleaning house and must now focus on integration.
cues.zh: 说他的政府已经完成了整顿任务，现在必须把重点放在融入上。

cues.en: Now can we have full focus on integration of children?
cues.zh: 现在，我们能把全部重点放在儿童融入上吗？

cues.en: When he came into office, shootings and explosions were an almost daily occurrence, with turf wars between drug networks plaguing many Swedish cities.
cues.zh: 他上任时，枪击和爆炸几乎每天发生，毒品网络之间的地盘争斗困扰着瑞典许多城市。

cues.en: The deadly violence has decreased, with homicides hitting the lowest level in a decade.
cues.zh: 致命暴力事件已经减少，凶杀案降至十年来最低水平。

cues.en: But the criminal gangs are still active, recruiting children and teenagers to run their errands for them.
cues.zh: 但犯罪团伙仍然活跃，招募儿童和青少年为他们跑腿。

cues.en: Crime and migration remain central to the government's case for re-election.
cues.zh: 犯罪和移民问题仍是政府争取连任的核心议题。

cues.en: As voters choose between the parties that make up Sweden's two main political coalitions,
cues.zh: 选民将在组成瑞典两大政治联盟的政党之间作出选择，

cues.en: the governing centre-right bloc
cues.zh: 一个是执政的中右翼阵营，

cues.en: and the centre-left led by former prime minister Magdalena Andersson's Social Democrats,
cues.zh: 另一个是由前首相玛格达莱娜·安德松领导的中左翼社会民主党，

cues.en: the largest party in every election for more than a century.
cues.zh: 该党一个多世纪以来一直是每次选举中的最大政党。

cues.en: Most polls have put the opposition ahead,
cues.zh: 多数民调显示反对派领先，

cues.en: but they are more splintered ideologically than the right.
cues.zh: 但他们在意识形态上比右翼更加分裂。

cues.en: The main thing uniting them is their opposition to the Sweden Democrats.
cues.zh: 把他们团结在一起的主要因素，是他们都反对瑞典民主党。

cues.en: In a country often viewed internationally as the epitome of the welfare state, frustration over its failures has dominated the election campaign.
cues.zh: 瑞典常被国际社会视为福利国家的典范，但人们对其失误的不满主导了这场竞选。

cues.en: With voters saying they want more investment in health services and schools.
cues.zh: 选民表示，他们希望在医疗服务和学校方面增加投入。

cues.en: This is the first general election since Sweden moved away from its centuries-old policy of military non-alignment and joined NATO,
cues.zh: 这是瑞典放弃延续数百年的军事不结盟政策并加入北约以来的首次大选，

cues.en: a major shift prompted by the war in Ukraine.
cues.zh: 这一重大转变由乌克兰战争促成。

cues.en: On this and on the importance of investing in defence, nothing much will change after election day, regardless of which coalition is in power.
cues.zh: 无论哪个联盟执政，选举日之后，在这一点以及增加国防投入的重要性上，都不会有太大变化。

cues.en: Stephanie Zakrisson with that report.
cues.zh: 以上是斯蒂芬妮·扎克里松的报道。

cues.en: Now to tennis, and the last Grand Slam of the year, the US Open in New York.
cues.zh: 下面关注网球：年度最后一项大满贯赛事——纽约举行的美国网球公开赛。

cues.en: And it was Elena Rybakina who proved that she's the undisputed world number one,
cues.zh: 埃琳娜·莱巴金娜证明了自己是当之无愧的世界第一，

cues.en: after beating two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka to win her first US Open women's singles title.
cues.zh: 她击败两届卫冕冠军阿丽娜·萨巴伦卡，首次赢得美网女单冠军。

cues.en: It's the third Grand Slam title for Rybakina and the second of the year after she beat Sabalenka in the Australian Open final.
cues.zh: 这是莱巴金娜的第三座大满贯冠军，也是她今年的第二座，此前她在澳网决赛击败了萨巴伦卡。

cues.en: And as our tennis correspondent Russell Fuller told me, it was a composed and ultimately dominant performance by the Kazakhstan player.
cues.zh: 正如网球记者拉塞尔·富勒告诉我的，这是这位哈萨克斯坦球员沉着且最终占据压倒性优势的表现。

cues.en: Elena Rybakina took Aryna Sabalenka's US Open title away from her in the way that she is already taking her world number one position away,
cues.zh: 埃琳娜·莱巴金娜夺走了阿丽娜·萨巴伦卡的美网冠军，正如她已经取代对方成为世界第一一样，

cues.en: by winning the deciding set by six games to two.
cues.zh: 她以6比2赢下决胜盘。

cues.en: And she played at an exceptionally high level in that final set, never in trouble on serve, and broke Aryna Sabalenka twice.
cues.zh: 她在决胜盘发挥出极高水平，发球局从未遇到麻烦，还两度破掉阿丽娜·萨巴伦卡的发球局。

cues.en: This was after Sabalenka had levelled the match and was improving as she won the second set 7-5.
cues.zh: 此前萨巴伦卡以7比5赢下第二盘扳平比分，状态也有所提升。

cues.en: But whereas Rybakina was completely in control of her game and her emotions, Sabalenka's body language was appalling at times,
cues.zh: 但莱巴金娜完全掌控着比赛和情绪，萨巴伦卡的肢体语言有时却糟糕至极，

cues.en: and she did probably give Elena Rybakina a helping hand in that she was constantly getting very upset with herself.
cues.zh: 她不断因自己的表现而非常沮丧，或许确实帮了埃琳娜·莱巴金娜一把。

cues.en: She was lucky not to be docked a point for smashing a racket,
cues.zh: 她砸球拍却没有被罚掉一分，算是很幸运，

cues.en: and she cut the look of a figure who didn't believe she could beat Rybakina
cues.zh: 她看起来不相信自己能击败莱巴金娜，

cues.en: and that was probably close to the truth because Rybakina was quite superb.
cues.zh: 这或许接近事实，因为莱巴金娜的表现相当出色。

cues.en: Elena Rybakina, I'm right in saying, became number one over the course of this tournament; Sabalenka is now number two,
cues.zh: 我说得没错的话，埃琳娜·莱巴金娜在本届赛事期间登上了世界第一；萨巴伦卡现在是第二，

cues.en: but could this be a rivalry we could see for years to come?
cues.zh: 但这会不会成为一场持续多年的对决？

cues.en: These two pulling away from the rest of the pack?
cues.zh: 这两人会不会逐渐甩开其他选手？

cues.en: Yes, I think it's the best rivalry in women's tennis.
cues.zh: 是的，我认为这是女子网坛最精彩的对决。

cues.en: They've played together a lot of times, 18 times now.
cues.zh: 她们交手过很多次，现在已经是18次了。

cues.en: Sabalenka has won 10 of their 18 matches, so it's very, very close indeed.
cues.zh: 萨巴伦卡赢下了其中10场，双方确实非常接近。

cues.en: And we shall see, given their ages—28, Sabalenka, 27, Rybakina—they have a number of years still left in their prime.
cues.zh: 考虑到她们的年龄——萨巴伦卡28岁、莱巴金娜27岁——她们的巅峰期还会持续很多年。

cues.en: And they will certainly start 2027 as the players to beat.
cues.zh: 她们无疑会以最具竞争力的选手身份开启2027年。

cues.en: Coco Gauff is not too far behind them.
cues.zh: 可可·高芙也并未落后太远。

cues.en: There's also the likes of Iga Świątek of Poland, who's had a difficult couple of years,
cues.zh: 此外还有波兰的伊加·斯维亚泰克，她经历了艰难的几年，

cues.en: and Jessica Pegula of the United States, and also some up-and-coming younger players.
cues.zh: 以及美国的杰西卡·佩古拉，还有一些正在崭露头角的年轻选手。

cues.en: Iva Jovic, the American, is only 18 and has really caught the eye this year.
cues.zh: 美国选手伊娃·约维奇只有18岁，今年确实吸引了很多关注。

cues.en: But these two, I think, certainly would be in the strongest position when the Australian Open takes place in January,
cues.zh: 但我认为，这两人在一月举行的澳网开赛时，无疑会处于最有利的位置，

cues.en: another hard-court Grand Slam where these two are usually at their best.
cues.zh: 那是另一项硬地大满贯赛事，也是她们通常发挥最佳的赛场。

cues.en: Our tennis correspondent Russell Fuller.
cues.zh: 网球记者拉塞尔·富勒的报道。

cues.en: And that's all from us for now. If you want to get in touch,
cues.zh: 本期节目暂告一段落。如果你想联系我们，

cues.en: you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 可以发送邮件至 globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: This edition of the Global News Podcast was mixed by Calum McLean, and the producer was Emma Joseph.
cues.zh: 本期《全球新闻播客》由卡勒姆·麦克莱恩混音，制片人为艾玛·约瑟夫。

cues.en: The editor is Karen Martin. I am Pete Ross. Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 编辑是凯伦·马丁。我是皮特·罗斯。下期再见。
